submittedPrompt: 绘制并排三个完整独立公开分享文档编辑窄网页，宽比例390、320、320，白灰蓝平面，第二图是实际结构。三页头蓝书本DooKnow、分享笔记、可编辑徽章，绝不加主人导航。工具区文档编辑蓝选中、Markdown 源码普通，两按钮平分窄页一整行；下一行状态、保存修改、返回阅读。固定说明“编辑这篇笔记后请手动保存。不支持上传附件；引用的白板仅供查看。”。文档白色编辑区只显示标题让知识保持可用、正文用于公开页面盘点的隔离示例，不包含真实用户资料。、小标题记录与回顾、结尾把观察留下，给下一步提供线索。，底部正文字符 56。页脚由DooKnow分享 | 内容随原笔记保存同步更新。左状态已保存，保存修改灰禁用，其余可用。中结尾改“把想法留下，给下一步提供线索。”，同字符56，状态未保存，保存修改蓝可用、模式和返回阅读可用。右保留中页完整文档与未保存状态，顶部说明后红色“分享已到期、取消或链接已重置，无法保存。当前编辑已保留，可复制保存到本地。”，可用按钮重新载入最新内容；保存修改灰禁用，但文档仍可编辑、两个模式和返回阅读仍可用，不把文档变灰只读。文字窄处自然换行、正文独立滚动；不加富文本工具栏、插入、上传、标题输入框或自动保存提示。

sourceContracts.title: 公开编辑：文档模式
permissionRules: Capability grants edit only of this shared note; referenced whiteboards always view-only.
Source/write require edit token and supported document; maintenance blocks both. Write requires same Origin, JSON and separate anonymous CSRF; 30 requests/minute token rate.
Save uses expectedModifiedAt and stable requestId for same pending content/version; no owner private asset API.

PublicShareEditor initializes kind=document directly. NoteEditorHost calls parseSource with source-codec eligibility enabled=true; do not infer that public rich editing is disabled by the owner VITE_DOCUMENT_EDITOR_ENABLED setting.
The active public token and source/save restrictions remain authoritative in both modes, including after a rich-eligibility fallback; an empty body is not a validation failure.

A resolved embedded whiteboard uses the current share board endpoint and board.capabilities.canDownloadSource; only that resolved capability governs source-tab availability. The server includes source content/path only when allowDiagramSource and the underlying resource permit it.

DiagramPreview canEdit requires !readOnly && !shareToken && resourceEdit; canGenerate additionally requires editable=true. A guest/shareToken can never edit design, edit diagram source, convert to whiteboard or generate portable preview, even when original-source download is allowed.

fields.name: draft
fields.constraints: Markdown source; manual save; existing resource references retained; no new private images/whiteboards/uploads; blank draft is allowed. The save JSON payload must contain a string content property, including an empty string; payload-property presence is separate from UI/nonempty validation. Save eligibility is dirty-state and busy/loading/composing/blocked/expiry based, not nonempty based.

actions.label: 保存修改
actions.effect: Fetch anonymous CSRF and CAS save current draft

actions.label: Ctrl/Cmd+F / Ctrl/Cmd+H
actions.effect: Open current shared-note find and replace panel (workspace shared surface WS-045)
actions.guard: editor keyboard event; Ctrl or Meta; not Alt; not composing

actions.label: 上一个/下一个匹配 / 区分大小写 / 关闭查找
actions.effect: Navigate or refine current-note matches; Escape/close restores editor focus

actions.label: 替换当前 / 全部替换
actions.effect: Modify current shared-note draft; explicit public save still required
actions.guard: not readOnly; results exist; replacement handler refuses while composing

actions.label: 预览 / 源码（解析后的白板卡片）
actions.effect: Switch resolved board presentation; source panel includes local source download only for returned source bytes
actions.guard: Source tab only when resolved board.capabilities.canDownloadSource; capability never grants diagram editing/generation

actions.label: 下载源码（解析后的白板源码面板）
actions.effect: Download the local sourceText as diagram.excalidraw/svg/mmd; for Excalidraw sourceText is boardSource || provided scene || fence code, without an extra source.path fetch
actions.api: local Blob download; no owner asset API
actions.guard: source panel reachable only for current allowed source capability; no invented private source fetch

importantStates: no upload warning; existing attachments and diagram views retained
rich-editor fallback to source with warning
Blank body is valid; a dirty deletion to empty can be saved when the ordinary save guards permit it. An unchanged blank baseline is clean, not invalid.

Ctrl/Cmd+F or Ctrl/Cmd+H inside either mode opens the shared current-note find/replace panel; zero results disables next/previous and replacement actions. Escape closes it; case-sensitive matching, current replacement and replace-all remain local draft operations.
Find remains available while host readOnly is true; replacement input/actions are disabled while readOnly (busy/reloading), and replacement is guarded during composition.

Initial mode is document for a readable edit-capability source. parseSource rejects rich eligibility only when UTF-8 bytes exceed262144, source units exceed5000, nesting depth exceeds32, or cross-paragraph reference-link syntax requires preserving global references; fallback emits warning and switches to Markdown source.

Guest-reachable document context includes table controls, image description/delete/preview, existing-link edit/remove/open, preserved-source copy/delete confirmation and unsupported-paste choice; these reuse shared editor surfaces without owner publication/upload/navigation permissions.

Public graph-document and Excalidraw-reference read projections may be ordinary PNG preview images with public explanatory body and no source tab/download control; source-allowed setting does not turn such an image into an editor.

When an embedded whiteboard is actually resolved into DiagramPreview (including public rich editing), canDownloadSource=false hides the source tab and clears a previously visible source panel; preview/expand/retry remain the appropriate read controls.

For a resolved board whose capability explicitly permits source, source tab reveals only returned sourceText and its local Download source action. The same card still has no edit/convert/generate controls for a shareToken.

responsive.supported: Source-defined responsive layout; not runtime-verified in this read-only inventory
responsive.behavior: Toolbar wraps; <=720px mode buttons share full width and article padding decreases (PublicShareEditor.vue:329). Editor behavior at 320 remains unverified.

sourceContracts.designReason: A concrete page with its own content, action hierarchy and business state; include in the GPT Image 2 review queue before implementation.
notes: Shared find/replace layout and detailed controls cross-reference coverage/workspace.json WS-045; public reachability is through NoteEditorHost keyboard handling, not an owner toolbar button.

PublicShareEditor exposes document/source mode, save and return-reading controls. It does not mount the owner full editor toolbar or handle NoteEditorHost insert-menu events, so do not add an owner insert menu to the public mockup.

Guest document context cross-references: WS-034 table toolbar, WS-035 image settings, WS-036 contextual link actions, WS-037 edit link, WS-038 image preview/zoom, WS-039 copy preserved original, WS-040 delete preserved content, WS-041 unsupported paste choice. These are shared-component layouts with public-specific guards, not duplicate owner-only pages.

Image preview resolves through the current share; replacement/upload actions emit the existing public upload-not-supported warning. Editing/deleting image descriptions or links changes the draft only; new private resource references remain rejected at save.

The public rich-eligibility fallback is distinct from a document chunk-load error: NoteEditorHost shows a preserved-content load-error warning and suggests switching modes; it does not mark the owner feature flag as public eligibility.
Actual shared component path is apps/web/components/DiagramPreview.vue; there is no PublicDiagramPreview.vue at this baseline.

Ordinary inline SVG/Mermaid code already present in shared Markdown retains inline rendering; this is distinct from permission to fetch private/native board source. Do not infer original-source access from a source-tab screenshot or from note edit permission alone.

Download is a local Blob of sourceText: for Excalidraw this is boardSource || provided scene || fence code. The component does not fetch an owner asset or an extra source.path to fill missing source.content; do not depict such a fetch as implemented.

postprocessing: Original built-in PNG copied byte-for-byte; no pixel edits.
